resources.name: accounts
resources.label: name

filters.help: only accounts of this account type
only the sub-accounts of this account id

resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete an account that journal lines, products, tax agencies, sales or sub-accounts use. Make it inactive with `deactivate`.

fields.name: name
fields.help: account name, unique under its parent

fields.name: number
fields.help: account number (letters, digits, . and -), unique when set

fields.name: type
fields.help: account type; a sub-account has the type of its parent

fields.name: detail_type
fields.help: a detail type of the account type: `tinycld books accounts types` lists them

fields.name: description
fields.help: what the account is for

fields.name: parent
fields.help: the account this one is a sub-account of; empty for a top-level account

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive account is hidden from pickers and keeps its history

fields.name: form_1099_box
fields.help: the 1099 box that payments from this account report to; expense-group types only

fields.name: full_name
fields.help: the path from the top-level account, parts joined by a colon

fields.name: currency
fields.help: the currency of the books, set by the server

resources.name: customers
resources.summary: The people and companies the business sells to
resources.label: display_name

filters.help: only the sub-customers of this customer id

resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete a customer that has sub-customers or transactions. Make it inactive with `deactivate`.

fields.name: display_name
fields.help: the name shown in lists and on documents, unique among its siblings

fields.name: code
fields.help: the short code people type to find it (2 to 15 capital letters, digits or dashes); left out, the server makes one from the name; unique among customers

fields.name: company
fields.help: company name

fields.name: first_name
fields.help: first name of the contact person

fields.name: last_name
fields.help: last name of the contact person

fields.name: email
fields.help: email address

fields.name: phone
fields.help: phone number

fields.name: mobile
fields.help: mobile phone number

fields.name: website
fields.help: website URL, with its scheme (https://…)

fields.name: billing_address
fields.help: billing address

fields.name: shipping_address
fields.help: shipping address; null means the billing address

fields.name: notes
fields.help: internal notes

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive customer is hidden from pickers and keeps its history

fields.name: terms
fields.help: default payment terms of a new invoice; empty for none

fields.name: parent
fields.help: the top-level customer this one is a sub-customer of; empty for a top-level customer

fields.name: tax_exempt
fields.help: sales to this customer are not taxed

fields.name: exemption_reason
fields.help: why the customer is exempt from sales tax

fields.name: exemption_number
fields.help: the number of the exemption certificate

fields.name: default_tax_rate
fields.help: the tax rate or group a new sale to this customer starts with

resources.name: vendors
resources.summary: The people and companies the business buys from
resources.label: display_name
resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete a vendor that has transactions. Make it inactive with `deactivate`.

fields.name: display_name
fields.help: the name shown in lists and on documents, unique among vendors

fields.name: code
fields.help: the short code people type to find it (2 to 15 capital letters, digits or dashes); left out, the server makes one from the name; unique among vendors

fields.name: company
fields.help: company name

fields.name: first_name
fields.help: first name of the contact person

fields.name: last_name
fields.help: last name of the contact person

fields.name: email
fields.help: email address

fields.name: phone
fields.help: phone number

fields.name: mobile
fields.help: mobile phone number

fields.name: website
fields.help: website URL, with its scheme (https://…)

fields.name: address
fields.help: the vendor's address

fields.name: terms
fields.help: default payment terms of a new bill; empty for none

fields.name: account_number
fields.help: the business's account number at this vendor

fields.name: expense_account
fields.help: the account a new bill or expense line for this vendor starts with

fields.name: notes
fields.help: internal notes

fields.name: track_1099
fields.help: payments to this vendor are reported on a 1099

fields.name: legal_name
fields.help: the name on the vendor's W-9

fields.name: tax_id_type
fields.help: the kind of tax ID; empty for none

fields.name: tax_id
fields.help: the tax ID: nine digits, with or without dashes; stored as 12-3456789 (EIN) or 123-45-6789 (SSN)

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive vendor is hidden from pickers and keeps its history

resources.name: products
resources.summary: Products and services: what the business sells and buys
resources.label: name

filters.help: only products of this type: service, non_inventory, inventory or bundle

resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete a product that a bundle or a transaction line uses. Make it inactive with `deactivate`.

fields.name: type
fields.help: service, non_inventory, inventory or bundle; only a new product can be an inventory item or a bundle, and each keeps its type

fields.name: name
fields.help: the product name, unique among products

fields.name: code
fields.help: the short code people type to find it (2 to 15 capital letters, digits or dashes); left out, the server makes one from the name; unique among products

fields.name: sku
fields.help: stock keeping unit; may repeat

fields.name: sales_description
fields.help: the description a sales line starts with

fields.name: price
fields.help: sales price in cents (1250 is 12.50); not for a bundle

fields.name: income_account
fields.help: an active Income or Other income account; needed for a service, non_inventory or inventory product, not for a bundle

fields.name: purchases
fields.help: the business also buys this product; then expense_account is needed; always true for an inventory item

fields.name: purchase_description
fields.help: the description a purchase line starts with

fields.name: cost
fields.help: purchase cost in cents; not for a bundle

fields.name: expense_account
fields.help: the account a purchase of this product posts to; not Accounts receivable or Accounts payable; for an inventory item, its Cost of goods sold account (empty takes the chart's)

fields.name: asset_account
fields.help: inventory item only: an active Other current asset account that holds the stock value; empty takes the chart's Inventory asset account; it cannot change after the item has stock transactions

fields.name: preferred_vendor
fields.help: inventory item only: the vendor the item is usually bought from; empty for none

fields.name: reorder_point
fields.help: inventory item only: the quantity on hand at which to buy more, from 0 to 1000000

fields.name: opening_quantity
fields.help: inventory item only: the quantity on hand at opening_date, at most 2 decimals; Books posts it as an opening inventory adjustment

fields.name: opening_value
fields.help: inventory item only: the value of the opening quantity in cents; needs an opening_quantity

fields.name: opening_date
fields.help: inventory item only: the day of the opening stock, YYYY-MM-DD; needed with an opening_quantity, not in a closed period

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive product is hidden from pickers and keeps its history

fields.name: taxable
fields.help: sales of this product are taxed

fields.name: quantity_on_hand
fields.help: inventory item only: the quantity in stock, kept by the server from the posted stock transactions

fields.name: stock_value
fields.help: inventory item only: the value of the stock in cents, kept by the server from the posted stock transactions

fields.name: currency
fields.help: the currency of the books, set by the server

resources.name: bundle-items

filters.help: only the items of this bundle (a product id)
only the items that hold this product id

resources.deleteHelp: Deleting an item takes the product out of the bundle. Deleting the bundle deletes its items.

fields.name: bundle
fields.help: the bundle (a product of type bundle); it cannot change later

fields.name: product
fields.help: an active product that is not a bundle

fields.name: quantity
fields.help: how many of the product one bundle holds, from 0.01 to 1000000

fields.name: position
fields.help: the item's place in the bundle, from 0

resources.name: tax-agencies
resources.summary: The agencies the business pays sales tax to
resources.label: name
resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete an agency that has tax rates. Make it inactive with `deactivate`, after its rates.

fields.name: name
fields.help: the agency name, unique among agencies

fields.name: account
fields.help: an active Other current liability account that holds the tax owed to the agency

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive agency is hidden from pickers

resources.name: tax-rates
resources.summary: Sales tax rates, and the groups that charge several rates as one
resources.label: name

filters.help: only the rates of this tax agency id

resources.deleteHelp: The server refuses to delete the default rate, a rate that an active group holds, and a rate that a sale used. Make it inactive with `deactivate`.

fields.name: type
fields.help: rate or group; it cannot change later

fields.name: name
fields.help: the name, unique among rates and groups

fields.name: rate_ppm
fields.help: the rate in parts per million of the taxable amount: 1% is 10000, 8.875% is 88750; 0 for a group

fields.name: agency
fields.help: the active agency a rate is paid to; empty for a group

fields.name: components
fields.help: for a group: its two to ten rates, none of them a group; empty for a rate

fields.name: is_default
fields.help: the rate or group a new sale starts with; setting it clears the earlier default

fields.name: inactive
fields.help: an inactive rate or group is hidden from pickers
